event: Poulati water-sharing system established; persists under Venetian (1207-1617) and Ottoman (1617-1821) rule
Poulati monastery built; owners donate water time ('each proprietor had his day and his hours')
Water rights begin to be written into land contracts and inheritance deeds
More than 25 farmers in Poulati
Municipality buys parts to maintain the "old desalination units" at Kamares
Water trucked from the Kamares desalination plant up to the Apollonia tank, and to the Agios Merkourios tank for Artemonas; repeated into September
A Hoh desalination unit of 250 m3/day is named in a spare-parts order
Cadastre splits plots, separating a communal cistern from its spring
Equipment bought to manage brine at the Kamares desalination plants
Municipality hires support to license its two existing desalination installations, at Kamares and Platys Gialos, and two sewage plants
Council adds a portable reverse-osmosis unit of at least 1,000 m3/day to a funding bid (Filodimos programme)
Ministry of Maritime Affairs grants a temporary installation and operating permit for a desalination unit at Platys Gialos
Tender for a portable 1,000 m3/day seawater reverse-osmosis unit
Interior Ministry pays EUR 77,670 towards running the desalination plants; such grants recur (2021, 2024, 2025)
The portable 1,000 m3/day unit is received
Ministry funds the repair and modernisation of the existing 500 m3/day unit at Platys Gialos and the rebuilding of its site
Seasonal operating contracts: the brackish-water unit at Kamares for five months, the seawater unit at Platys Gialos
Municipal decision 104/2021: measures to cut water use because of prolonged drought
Tanker truck hired to carry water from the Platys Gialos plant to the Agios Merkourios tank
The old reverse-osmosis container at Platys Gialos is shipped away for repair
Civil Protection emergency for coastal erosion (29 Nov 2021) that damaged coastal roads; landslides of 21-26 Nov 2023 added later; extended every six months, now to 4 May 2027. Not a water emergency
STARTS4Water 'Cisterns Know' residency; artwork in the main square, summer 2022
Six farmers left, four over 75
Study proposes 20-year water plan with wastewater reuse
Ministry funds the upgrade and running of the desalination units for three years
A 14 m3 tanker truck hired for tourist-season demand, carrying water from both plants to the village tanks; ministry pays for tanker hire
Tankers hired to fill the tanks at Kades, Apelaiti, Faros and Katavati (school); hired again in 2024, 2025 and 2026
Karavos merominia interview (rain and seed)
Desalination breakdown at Platys Gialos; some settlements without water for 10-15 days; at some points June use was up to double the previous August (13 to 25 m3 an hour at one seaside spot)
Civil Protection declares a water emergency for one month, to 22 Jul 2024, for consequences that "may arise" from water shortage
notes: ADA ΨΘΙΟ46ΝΠΙΘ-91Μ. Press called it the first Cycladic island, but Serifos had been under a water emergency since 30 Apr 2024 (DIAVGEIA_GSCP); local reporting notes no public information on the island. Extended to 22 Aug (see 2024-07-22)

event: Council decision 104/2024 on proposals against wasteful use, for sharing water fairly between residents and visitors during the emergency
Civil Protection extends the water emergency by one month, to 22 Aug 2024, because the works to deal with the shortage are not finished
Tender for materials to repair and upgrade the desalination units, EUR 170,000 incl. VAT
Sifnos named among 7 islands for a national demand study to 2030
Karavos's forecast article closes on drought harming harvests
Council takes up the licensing of swimming pools on Sifnos (postponed)
CARDIMED demo revives stone check dams
Technical adviser hired to prepare a bid for a new desalination unit
Consultation on a portable 1,000 m3/day RO unit powered by renewables
Committee approves the study for a portable 1,000 m3/day solar-assisted reverse-osmosis unit and applies for funding
Standard environmental commitments set for a municipal desalination unit on Sifnos
Region includes "Extension of the Platys Gialos desalination installations" (OPS 6051846) in the South Aegean 2021-2027 programme: a 1,000 m3/day RO unit with 50.84 kWp of solar, EUR 1.05m
notes: ADA 9Ξ1Α7ΛΞ-ΔΨΞ. Probably the same unit as the portable solar-assisted one (study Feb 2026, permit Sep 2026)

event: Emergency water-saving measures: no network water for gardens, washing yards or cars, or filling pools; fines and possible cuts for repeat offenders; residents urged to use private cisterns; possible rotating cuts
Works permit for the 1,000 m3/day solar-assisted portable unit at Platys Gialos
Open tender for "Extension of the Platys Gialos desalination installations", estimated EUR 850,000 + 24% VAT (EUR 1,054,000)
Extension tender cancelled and to be re-run (municipal committee decision 206/2026); well-drilling company due on the island
notes: ADA 94ΕΟΩ1Τ-ΛΛΗ. Reason not stated in the title

event: Backup network installed for the Kamares desalination plants
